subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw adopt paired-node native Claude CLI execution, streaming node invokes, and the new session/plugin runtime placement fields as permanent supported core contracts?
rationale: The implementation adds durable configuration, protocol, persisted-session, and Plugin SDK surfaces whose permanence and ownership cannot be decided from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Adopt the contracts
options.body: Approve the generic streaming and placement contracts, retain node-local opt-in, remove accidental SDK leakage, and require live proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Keep paired-node catalog rows view-only until a smaller generic node-agent contract is designed with fewer public and persisted surfaces.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Defer the PR if native vendor CLI execution on paired nodes is outside the intended core product boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the contracts
recommendation.body: Approve the generic streaming and placement contracts, retain node-local opt-in, remove accidental SDK leakage, and require live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects this person to node-host execution, approval, CLI runtime, and process-resolution architecture.
